description: Calibrate the NLS scanner against reviewed human nucleus- and cytosol-annotated proteomes to show the zero score for AHSP is informative
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

BASIC=set("KR")
RE_CHELSKY=re.compile(r"(?=(K[KR].[KR]))")
def pat4(s):
    return sum(1 for i in range(len(s)-3)
               if sum(c in BASIC for c in s[i:i+4])==4
               or (sum(c in BASIC for c in s[i:i+4])==3 and any(c in "HP" for c in s[i:i+4])))
def pat7(s):
    n=0
    for i,c in enumerate(s):
        if c=="P":
            for off in (1,2,3):
                w=s[i+off:i+off+4]
                if len(w)==4 and sum(x in BASIC for x in w)>=3: n+=1
    return n
def bipart(s):
    n=0
    for i in range(len(s)-1):
        if s[i] in BASIC and s[i+1] in BASIC:
            for sp in range(10,13):
                w=s[i+2+sp:i+2+sp+5]
                if len(w)==5 and sum(x in BASIC for x in w)>=3: n+=1
    return n
def nls_total(s): return len(RE_CHELSKY.findall(s))+pat4(s)+pat7(s)+bipart(s)

def fetch(sl, n=400):
    url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?format=fasta&query="
         f"(cc_scl_term:{sl})+AND+(reviewed:true)+AND+(organism_id:9606)+AND+(length:[60+TO+400])")
    t=requests.get(url,timeout=120).text
    out={};k=None
    for line in t.split("\n"):
        if line.startswith(">"): k=line[1:]; out[k]=""
        elif k and line.strip(): out[k]+=line.strip()
    return {k:v for k,v in out.items() if 60<=len(v)<=400}

nuc=fetch("SL-0191")      # Nucleus
cyt=fetch("SL-0173")      # Cytosol
print(f"reviewed human proteins 60-400 aa:  nucleus (SL-0191) n={len(nuc)},  cytosol (SL-0173) n={len(cyt)}")
# remove proteins annotated to both compartments
both=set(k.split("|")[1] for k in nuc) & set(k.split("|")[1] for k in cyt)
nuc={k:v for k,v in nuc.items() if k.split("|")[1] not in both}
cyt={k:v for k,v in cyt.items() if k.split("|")[1] not in both}
print(f"after removing {len(both)} dual-annotated entries:  nucleus n={len(nuc)}, cytosol n={len(cyt)}")

nn=np.array([nls_total(s) for s in nuc.values()])
nc=np.array([nls_total(s) for s in cyt.values()])
HUM=("MALLKANKDLISAGLKEFSVLLNQQVFNDPLVSEEDMVTVVEDWMNFYINYYRQQVTGEPQERDKALQELRQELNTLANPFLAKYRDFLKSHELPSHPPPSS")
ahsp=nls_total(HUM)

sens=(nn>0).mean(); fpr=(nc>0).mean()
tab=np.array([[(nn>0).sum(),(nn==0).sum()],[(nc>0).sum(),(nc==0).sum()]])
odds,p=stats.fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\n=== Calibration of the NLS scanner on human reference sets ===")
print(f"nucleus-annotated proteins with >=1 NLS match : {(nn>0).sum()}/{len(nn)} = {100*sens:.1f}% (sensitivity)")
print(f"cytosol-annotated proteins with >=1 NLS match : {(nc>0).sum()}/{len(nc)} = {100*fpr:.1f}% (false-positive rate)")
print(f"Fisher exact odds ratio = {odds:.2f}, p = {p:.3g}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U on match counts: p = {stats.mannwhitneyu(nn,nc,alternative='greater').pvalue:.3g}")
print(f"mean matches: nucleus {nn.mean():.2f}, cytosol {nc.mean():.2f}")
print(f"\nAHSP (Q9NZD4) total NLS matches = {ahsp}")
print(f"  percentile of AHSP within nuclear set  : {100*(nn<=ahsp).mean():.1f}% of nuclear proteins score <= AHSP")
print(f"  percentile of AHSP within cytosolic set: {100*(nc<=ahsp).mean():.1f}% of cytosolic proteins score <= AHSP")
# negative predictive value of a zero score
npv=(nc==0).sum()/((nc==0).sum()+(nn==0).sum())
print(f"  among all proteins scoring 0, fraction annotated cytosol-only = {100*npv:.1f}%")

bench=pd.DataFrame(dict(set=["nucleus (SL-0191)"]*len(nn)+["cytosol (SL-0173)"]*len(nc),
                        nls_matches=np.concatenate([nn,nc])))
bench.to_csv("ahsp_nls_scanner_calibration.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
bins=np.arange(-0.5,13.5)
ax[0].hist([nn,nc],bins=bins,density=True,label=[f"nucleus (n={len(nn)})",f"cytosol (n={len(cyt)})"],
           color=["#E45756","#4C78A8"])
ax[0].axvline(0,color="k",lw=2.5)
ax[0].text(0.25,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.78,"AHSP = 0 matches",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
ax[0].set_xlabel("total classical NLS matches per protein"); ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction of proteins")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_title("A. Scanner calibration on reviewed human proteins (60-400 aa).\n"
                f"Sensitivity {100*sens:.0f}%, false-positive rate {100*fpr:.0f}%, Fisher p = {p:.1e}",fontsize=10)
ax[1].bar([0,1],[100*sens,100*fpr],color=["#E45756","#4C78A8"])
ax[1].set_xticks([0,1]); ax[1].set_xticklabels(["nucleus-annotated","cytosol-annotated"])
ax[1].set_ylabel("% of proteins with >=1 NLS match")
for i,v in enumerate([100*sens,100*fpr]): ax[1].text(i,v+1,f"{v:.1f}%",ha="center",fontweight="bold")
ax[1].axhline(0,color="k")
ax[1].annotate("AHSP: 0 matches\n(scores with the cytosolic set)",xy=(1,100*fpr),
               xytext=(0.45,100*fpr+18),fontsize=9,
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=1.2))
ax[1].set_title("B. A zero NLS score is informative, not a method failure",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
